purpose: Daytime commercial self-consumption with optional surplus export; compare PV only, PV plus ESS, and grid only

load.shape_note: ASSUMED hourly weights. Daytime: 08-18h weight 1, otherwise 0.1; flat: 1; evening: 17-23h weight 1, otherwise 0.1. Annual normalization 36500 kWh. All days identical; no actual facility measurements.

battery.dispatch: PV serves load first, surplus charges battery, then exports; battery serves remaining load. No grid charging, price arbitrage, outage reserve, or demand-charge optimization.

cost.currency: KRW in constant prices; hypothetical sensitivity inputs, not current Korean quotes
cost.residual_note: Scenario only: recovery fraction times unexpired straight-line capital value. Not a resale appraisal. No future operating revenue is added on top. Ground treatment and fixed project costs have zero residual value.

area.note: Reference geometry pitch 2m; planning area proxy only, excludes ESS footprint. No site boundary constraints in this screening.

excluded: Actual KEPCO contract and demand charges
VAT, taxes, financing, grants, REC and contract eligibility
Product-specific ESS degradation and thermal loads
Discrete string, inverter and ESS product compatibility
Site-specific land rental and interconnection upgrade quotes
